title: Driving or Traveling? Is it against the law to require a Driver's License?
summary: Reads the full Thompson v. Smith opinion often quoted for a right to drive without a licence and shows it upholds regulation under police power.

assertions.quote: they just look up partial citations and they take it as gospel

verdicts.note: The cases cited (e.g. Thompson v. Smith) affirm that states may regulate and license driving; no court has held licences unnecessary.

assertions.quote: the case that he cited explicitly states that the police have the authority
go get a driver's license if you would like to safely travel us streets and roadways
ultimately what the court ruled was that the rules for licensed suspensions were ambiguous um and arbitrary and not reasonable

verdicts.note: The 1930 Virginia decision struck an arbitrary revocation ordinance while affirming the city's power to license drivers.
